items.html: And now we will explain the aforementioned matter at length; and afterward we will explain the superficial aspect of the language of the aforementioned saying. And first we will explain the matter of the order of the degrees of the worlds — in what manner they stood at first, before man was created, and how they descended from their degree after he sinned. Know that the discernment of the number of the worlds themselves did not change, for they are always the discernment of four, which are Atzilut, Beriah, Yetzirah, Assiyah.
